::: {.talk-entry}
### AI Agents Deserve R

::: {.talk-meta}
posit::conf(2026) · September 2026 · [Slides](https://jameshwade.github.io/posit-conf-2026/) · [Repository](https://github.com/JamesHWade/posit-conf-2026)
:::

Typed data frames, `ellmer`, `deputy`, `dsprrr`, and reproducible notebooks make R a practical environment for agentic workflows, tool calling, and evaluation.
:::

::: {.talk-entry .tone-ochre}
### Disposable Shiny Apps

::: {.talk-meta}
posit::conf(2025) · September 18, 2025 · [Slides](https://github.com/JamesHWade/posit-conf-2025) · [Annotated Notes](posts/2025-09-18_disposable-shiny-apps-annotated.qmd)
:::

```{=html}
<div class="video-embed">
  <iframe src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/smnrmTtoiOM" title="Disposable Shiny Apps at posit::conf(2025)" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture" allowfullscreen></iframe>
</div>
```

Build more Shiny apps. Then throw them away. This talk makes the case for deliberately temporary apps: swap static slides for interactive conversations, build in hours instead of weeks, and use AI assistants to keep momentum high.
:::

::: {.talk-entry .tone-lake}
### Integrating AI Assistants into Shiny Apps

::: {.talk-meta}
R/Pharma 2024 · October 29, 2024 · [Slides](https://jameshwade.github.io/r-pharma-talk/)
:::

Practical patterns for embedding AI assistants into Shiny applications using `ellmer`, `shinychat`, and sidebots: how to streamline development and give users a natural language interface to your app's functionality.
:::

::: {.talk-entry .tone-pine}
### Posit Academy in the Age of Generative AI: Lessons from the Frontlines

::: {.talk-meta}
posit::conf(2024) · August 2024 · [Slides](https://jameshwade.github.io/posit-conf-2024/)
:::

```{=html}
<div class="video-embed">
  <iframe src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/7tcnho6PHOc" title="Posit Academy in the Age of Generative AI at posit::conf(2024)" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture" allowfullscreen></iframe>
</div>
```

How did Posit Academy learners respond to generative AI tools entering their workflow? More than half rated AI code assistants 2 stars or less. This talk explores threshold concepts for learning with AI coding tools and what that means for how we teach data science.
:::

::: {.talk-entry .tone-plum}

Tunis R User Group & R-Ladies Rome · 2024
:::


::: {.talk-entry .tone-ochre}
### Large Language Models in RStudio

::: {.talk-meta}
posit::conf(2023) · September 2023
:::

An introduction to integrating LLMs into the R and RStudio ecosystem, covering the tools and patterns that became the foundation for `gptstudio` and the wave of AI tooling that followed.
:::

::: {.talk-entry .tone-pine}
### Enabling Citizen Data Scientists with RStudio Academy

::: {.talk-meta}
RStudio Community Meetup · June 21, 2022 · [Video](https://youtu.be/lCrd3BMVVqQ) · [Slides](https://github.com/JamesHWade/talks/raw/main/2022-06_RStudio-Meetup_RStudio-Academy/20220621_RStudio-Meetup_RStudio-Academy.pdf)
:::

```{=html}
<div class="video-embed">
  <iframe src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/lCrd3BMVVqQ" title="Enabling Citizen Data Scientists with RStudio Academy" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture" allowfullscreen></iframe>
</div>
```

In chemistry and materials science research, data is messy, unstructured, and scattered. Solving this problem requires researchers to deeply embed within data generation and analysis workflows. I share lessons learned through teaching, community building, and collaboration with a focus on RStudio Academy.
:::
